name: Heavy Personnel PA Deep Post Shot

summary.motive: Weaponize the established Power Read Pull picture — same mesh, same pull, same lead — to bait the single-high safety downhill and take a deep post shot behind him.
summary.keyDefender: Free Safety — single-high defender who must honor heavy-run action or the deep middle
summary.whyItWorks: Every visual cue matches the run the defense has studied for weeks, so the safety’s downhill fit is correct football that loses anyway; the lone tell is X blocking nobody, and it is invisible until the stem.
summary.failureMode: A quarter-safety coverage or a disciplined post-safety who reads the X release early and sinks instead of fitting — the shot needs that downhill bite to exist.

beats.title: 1. Frame-for-Frame Deception
beats.text: The mesh, the pulling guard, the climbing tight end, the fullback lead — every offensive tell is identical to Power Read Pull. In heavy personnel against a single-high safety, the defense has earned the right to be wrong here.

beats.title: 2. The Safety’s Downhill Bite
beats.text: The free safety sees unblocked end, pulling guard, fullback lead — everything his run fits demand — and triggers downhill into the box. The moment he does, the deepest part of the field has nobody within twelve yards of it.

beats.title: 3. The Post Breaks Behind the Bite
beats.text: X has been stacking the corner since the snap because there is no stalk block coming — that absence is the only difference in the whole play. The post breaks inside at sixteen yards directly into the space the safety just vacated.

beats.title: 4. Corner Turn and Recovery Race
beats.text: The quarterback rises off the boot action and lets it go. The safety turns and runs but he is chasing from nine yards downhill; U’s clear-out seam has also dragged the strong-side corner away from any help.

beats.title: 5. Shot Money off Run Identity
beats.text: The catch lands where Roman designed it: the middle third, vacated by a bite he manufactured across four weeks of heavy-run film. This is why the power game exists — not just for yards, but for moments exactly like this one.

relations.tell: The backfield is a perfect copy of Power Read Pull, but X never blocks — his vertical release off the snap is the one frame that gives it away.
